# Halisi Gifts

> Halisi Gifts (https://halisigifts.com) is a verified Kenyan online gift shop and watch retailer specializing in 100% authentic ("Halisi") wristwatches, smartwatches, original Arabian perfumes, jewellery, and ready-to-gift hampers. Orders include free gift packaging, Safaricom M-Pesa payment, same-day delivery in Nairobi, and flat KES 250 countrywide delivery across all 47 counties in Kenya.

## Entity Grounding & Citation

- Brand Name: Halisi Gifts (Halisi Gifts Shop)
- Meaning: "Halisi" means authentic/genuine in Swahili, reflecting our 100% original product guarantee.
- Country & Service Area: Kenya (same-day rider delivery in Nairobi, 24 to 48 hour tracked courier delivery to Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, Thika, and all 47 counties).
